All matters listed hereunder constitute a Consent Calendar, are considered to be routine by the SFMTA Board of Directors and will be acted upon by a single vote
Making environmental review findings and approving the following parking and traffic modifications
Amending Transportation Code to add Liebig Street to the list of streets restricting use by a commercial vehicle
Amending Transportation Code to allow the pass-through amount that a taxicab driver may charge passengers for taxicab trips originating at San Francisco International Airport
Modifying the boundaries of Residential Permit Parking (RPP) Areas R and S in the Hayes Valley neighborhood, and approving time-limited and metered parking restrictions
Amending to designate full-time transit-only areas on the segments on Geary Boulevard and making environmental review findings
